build_biknn_radius_graph: build a biknn radius graph for a batch of atomic systems using the biknn_radius_graph function with PBC support
build_chunked_radius_graph: build a chunked radius graph for a single system using build_radius_graph_chunked to reduce peak memory usage
compute_segment_argsort: compute the argsort within each segment using segment_argsort_vectorized for batched ranking operations
compute_soft_ranks: compute soft ranks for a single padded segment using compute_soft_ranks_single_segment with vmap compatibility
run_batched_radius_graph: run batched radius graph construction across multiple systems using batched_radius_graph with configurable knn parameters
